quarterly_data.quarter: Huber+Suhner press release: HUBER+SUHNER successfully completes acquisition of Ingun (09-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Huber+Suhner closed the acquisition of Ingun Prüfmittelbau GmbH and Ingun International GmbH, including their subsidiaries (Constance, Germany; spring-loaded test probes, test fixture kits and accessories for testing printed circuit boards, electrical devices, connectors and batteries), announced in the release of 01.09.2026; Ingun operates as a business unit within the Industry segment.
